definition{
  name: dispatchText,
  parameters: [text : String],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match (prim split_exact text "\n" (4097 : UInt32) : (Option (List String)))

  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: dispatch,
  parameters: [request : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if ((prim length request : Nat) =? 0) then (respond (cons "status error" (cons "request empty" (nil String)))) else (if (4096 <? (prim length request : Nat)) then (respond (cons "status error" (cons "request too-large" (nil String)))) else (match (prim utf8_decode request : (Option String))
    | Option.none => (respond (cons "status error" (cons "request invalid-utf8" (nil String))))
    | Option.some text => (respond (dispatchText text))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}
